panels.title: JVM Memory, Recommendations and Formula
panels.description: Current runtime values respect the Replica selector; All shows the per-metric maximum across active JVM replicas. JVM formula candidate, candidate calculated Xmx, and Pod Rightsizing desired remain workload-level values and ignore the Replica selector. The panel compares the selected replica's current Xmx, request, and limit with those workload-level recommendations.

targets.expr:
WITH (
  identity = max by (namespace, pod, container, resource_id, workload_kind, workload_name) (
    last_over_time(
      kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", workload_name="$workload", status="running"}[$jvm_formula_lookback]
    )
    and on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (last_over_time(jvm_info{namespace="$namespace"}[$jvm_formula_lookback]))
  ),
  heap = max by (namespace, pod, container) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap", id="", namespace="$namespace"}),
  working_set = max by (namespace, pod, container) (
    container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}
  ),
  heap_p95 = quantile_over_time(0.95, heap[$jvm_formula_lookback:$jvm_formula_step]),
  outside_heap = clamp_min(working_set - on (namespace, pod, container) heap, 0),
  outside_heap_percentile = quantile_over_time($jvm_memory_strategy, outside_heap[$jvm_formula_lookback:$jvm_formula_step]),
  calculated_xmx = clamp_min(
    ceil((heap_p95 *(100 + $jvm_gc_buffer_percent) / 100) / 1048576)
    * 1048576,
    $jvm_xms_bytes
  ),
  candidate = calculated_xmx
  + outside_heap_percentile
  * (100 + $jvm_memory_buffer_percent)
  / 100
)
ceil(
  max by (namespace, resource_id, workload_kind, workload_name, container) (
    candidate
    * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (resource_id, workload_kind, workload_name) identity
  )
  / 1048576
)
* 1048576

panels.description: GC duration per elapsed second over the selected GC Lookback window, using reset-aware counter rates. ZGC cycle time and GC pause time are shown as separate series; concurrent cycle time is not application pause time. Diagnostic only; neither series feeds the Policy buffer or formula.
panels.title: GC Time

panels.description: Shows CPU usage and the configured CPU limit for the selected JVM workload and container.
panels.title: CPU Usage

list.description: Filters observed runtime values to one running JVM replica. Formula candidates and Pod Rightsizing desired remain workload-level values.

list.name: jvm_gc_lookback
list.label: GC Lookback
list.description: Rolling window for GC counter rates. Longer windows smooth short spikes.

Experimental read-only validation assumption for GC-family heap headroom. One selection applies to every displayed workload. Production should select a configured value from the detected GC family; PRD values are still TBD.
list.label: JVM GC Type Buffer % (Experimental)
list.name: jvm_gc_buffer_percent

list.description: Read-only validation input for buffering derived outside-heap memory. Set it to the active rightsizing Policy memory buffer.
list.label: JVM Policy Memory Buffer %
list.name: jvm_memory_buffer_percent

list.description: Aggregation strategy from the active rightsizing Policy, applied to container memory after heap is excluded. Heap remains P95 for the Xmx formula as required by PRD E.1.
list.label: JVM Policy Memory Strategy
list.name: jvm_memory_strategy

list.description: Rolling lookback used by historical JVM formula calculations. Set it to the active rightsizing Policy lookback when comparing recommendations.
list.label: JVM Policy Lookback
list.name: jvm_formula_lookback

list.description: Internal subquery resolution for formula estimates. Hidden because it is a query-performance setting, not a recommendation input.
list.label: JVM Formula Step
list.name: jvm_formula_step

list.description: Manual Xms floor for read-only validation. Select the value configured on the single selected workload; production must discover this from runtime telemetry or JVM arguments.
list.label: JVM Xms Floor (Manual)
list.name: jvm_xms_bytes
